review_locator: PMCID:PMC3696474, The organizing principle of the platelet glycoprotein Ib-IX-V complex; PMCID:PMC7854888, Structure-function of platelet glycoprotein Ib-IX
primary_title: Glycoprotein Ibalpha forms disulfide bonds with 2 glycoprotein Ibbeta subunits in the resting platelet.
decision_basis: Mutagenesis, peptide and coimmunoprecipitation assays support GPIbα-GPIbβ receptor-complex assembly at the bounded structural layer.
limitations_preserved: Preserve GPIbα-to-two-GPIbβ disulfide connectivity and resting-platelet stoichiometry; no autonomous subunit signaling or terminal-TF inference.

decision_basis: Structural, mutational and coimmunoprecipitation evidence supports GPIbβ-GPIX complex assembly at the bounded receptor-complex layer.
